overview: Indohyus is known from disarticulated Sindkhatudi material; bone density and tooth isotopes support aquatic use, while Raoellidae—not Indohyus—is sister to Cetacea.
overviewZh: Indohyus 来自 Sindkhatudi 骨层中分别编目的头骨、肢骨和牙齿；致密肢骨与牙齿同位素支持水域利用，系统树将 Raoellidae 而非 Indohyus 置于鲸类姐妹群位置。

ecology.diet: Diet remains unresolved; the tooth isotopes speak more directly to water use than to food choice.
ecology.habitat: Bone density and tooth isotopes support aquatic or riparian use, but do not record a complete habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Wading is an interpretation; the separately catalogued bones do not preserve a complete gait.
ecology.bodySize: The material represents a small raoellid, on the scale of other small artiodactyls.
ecology.guild: An aquatic or wading ecology is inferred; diet is not resolved.
ecology.dietZh: 食性仍未确定；牙齿同位素更直接反映其用水情况，而非食物选择。
ecology.habitatZh: 骨骼密度和牙齿同位素支持其利用水生或河岸环境，但没有记录完整的生境信息。
ecology.locomotionZh: 涉水是一种解释；另行编目的骨骼没有保存完整步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这些材料代表一种小型饶氏兽科动物，体型与其他小型偶蹄动物相当。
ecology.guildZh: 研究推断其可能具有水生或涉水生态；其食性尚未确定。

traits: Skull material preserves an involucrum, an ear-region thickening compared with cetaceans.
Sections through the long bones show dense bone tissue.
Stable-isotope measurements come from several teeth.
evidenceSummary: The Sindkhatudi sample supports aquatic or wading use and a Raoellidae–Cetacea sister relationship, but leaves diet, gait and direct ancestry unresolved.
evidenceSummaryZh: Sindkhatudi 的记录由散离的头骨、肢骨和牙齿材料组成。致密肢骨与牙齿同位素支持水生或涉水解释；发表的系统树则将 Raoellidae 放在 Cetacea 的姐妹群位置。食性、完整步态和直系祖先关系仍未解决。

readerLimitations.en: Skulls, limb bones and teeth were catalogued separately rather than as an associated skeleton. Bone density and tooth isotopes support aquatic or wading use, but do not settle diet or a complete gait.
readerLimitations.zh: 头骨、肢骨和牙齿分别编目，并非一具相连骨架。骨密度与牙齿同位素支持水生或涉水解释，却不能确定食性或完整步态。

traitsZh: 颅骨材料保存了鼓泡骨，即鲸类相较之下具有的一种耳区骨性增厚。
长骨切片显示骨组织密度较高。
稳定同位素测量来自多颗牙齿。

overview: Holotype H-GSP 18507 of *Ambulocetus natans* preserves a partial skull and vertebral column, plus substantial fore- and hind-limb material. The limbs could bear weight. Researchers used the combined vertebral and hind-limb anatomy to compare movement on land and in water; no gait or swimming performance was observed.
overviewZh: Ambulocetus natans 正模 H-GSP 18507 保存了部分头骨和脊柱，以及较多前肢与后肢材料。肢体能够承重。研究者依据脊柱和后肢的组合解剖特征比较陆地与水中运动；这些功能模型不是直接观察到的步态或游泳表现。

ecology.diet: Teeth and skull support an inference of aquatic predation, but no prey item is directly documented.
ecology.habitat: An amphibious way of life is inferred from the anatomy and formation context.
ecology.locomotion: Dorsoventral swimming and movement on land are functional models based on preserved anatomy.
ecology.bodySize: The partial skeleton represents a large-bodied early cetacean; it does not establish a full size range.
ecology.guild: The predator interpretation is anatomical inference, not an observed feeding event.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿和头骨支持其在水中捕食的推断，但没有直接记录到猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 根据解剖特征和地层背景推断其具有两栖生活方式。
ecology.locomotionZh: 根据保存的解剖特征建立了背腹向游泳和陆上移动的功能模型。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这具部分骨架代表一种体型较大的早期鲸类；它不能确定完整的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 捕食者的解释来自解剖特征推断，并非观察到的摄食事件。

traits: A partial skull and vertebral column
Substantial forelimbs and hind limbs that could bear weight
A mix of vertebral and limb features used in locomotor comparisons
evidenceSummary: The holotype preserves an anatomical mosaic used to infer amphibious movement. Otter-like swimming and sea-lion-like movement on land are comparisons with living animals, not observed behavior or proof of ancestry.
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模保存的骨骼组合被用于推断两栖运动。类似水獭的游泳和类似海狮的陆上移动，是与现生动物的比较，不是实际行为观察，也不证明祖先关系。

title.en: H-GSP 18507: bones behind the amphibious model
title.zh: H-GSP 18507 的骨骼与两栖运动模型

text.en: Holotype H-GSP 18507 of *Ambulocetus natans* preserves a partial skull and vertebral column, plus substantial fore- and hind-limb material. The limbs could bear weight. Researchers used the combined vertebral and hind-limb anatomy to compare movement on land and in water; no gait or swimming performance was observed.
text.zh: Ambulocetus natans 正模 H-GSP 18507 保存了部分头骨和脊柱，以及较多前肢与后肢材料。肢体能够承重。研究者依据脊柱和后肢的组合解剖特征比较陆地与水中运动；这些功能模型不是直接观察到的步态或游泳表现。

title.en: H-GSP 18507 preserves spine and limb material

text.en: The holotype preserves a partial skull and vertebral column together with substantial fore- and hind-limb material. This large-bodied early cetacean has limbs that could bear weight. Researchers used the vertebral and hind-limb anatomy together to compare movement on land and in water.
text.zh: 正模保存了部分头骨和脊柱，并包含相当数量的前肢与后肢材料。肢体能够支撑体重；研究者依据脊柱与后肢的组合解剖特征比较其在陆地和水中的运动。

title.en: Swimming and land movement are reconstructions
title.zh: 游泳与陆地移动是重建结果

text.en: The study infers amphibious movement from anatomy and formation context. Teeth and skull support an aquatic-predation interpretation, but no prey item is directly documented. Dorsoventral swimming, otter-like motion in water and sea-lion-like movement on land are comparisons with living animals, not observed performance.
text.zh: 研究依据解剖结构和地层背景推断其具有两栖运动能力。牙齿和头骨支持水生捕食的解释，但没有直接记录具体猎物。上下摆动游泳、类似水獭的水中运动以及类似海狮的陆上运动，都是与现生动物作出的比较，并非对化石动物运动表现的观察。

title.en: Fossil evidence for the origin of aquatic locomotion in archaeocete whales
title.zh: Fossil evidence for the origin of aquatic locomotion in archaeocete whales

scope.en: Thewissen et al. (1994), pp. 210?212, Figures 1?3: H-GSP 18507 anatomy, Kuldana Formation context and functional comparisons of terrestrial and aquatic movement.

readerLimitations.en: These interpretations rest on the partial holotype from the Kuldana Formation in Pakistan. The cited material does not define a full body-size range, exact swimming style, land performance or a genus-wide feeding pattern.
readerLimitations.zh: 这些解释依据的是巴基斯坦库尔达纳组出土的部分正模。所引材料未能确定完整体型范围、确切游泳方式、陆地运动表现或整个属的取食模式。

traitsZh: 前肢和后肢发达，能够承重。
用于运动比较的椎骨与四肢特征组合。

overview: CGM 60584 preserves an elongate posterior trunk, unfused sacrum and reduced limbs used to model tail-driven swimming; no fluke is securely preserved.
overviewZh: CGM 60584 保存较长后躯干、未融合骶椎与缩小四肢，为尾部推进增强的游泳模型提供依据；尾鳍和游泳表现并未可靠保存。

ecology.diet: Marine predation is inferred from cetacean teeth; prey is not preserved.
ecology.habitat: The known material comes from a marine lower Gehannam depositional setting at Wadi Al Hitan.
ecology.locomotion: Mid-body and tail undulation is inferred; a tail fluke is not preserved.
ecology.bodySize: A large protocetid represented by substantial associated remains; no exact body length is assigned here.
ecology.guild: Marine predation is inferred from anatomy rather than observed feeding.
ecology.dietZh: 根据鲸类牙齿推断其在海洋中捕食；未保存猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 已知材料来自 Wadi Al Hitan 的海相下 Gehannam 沉积环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 研究推断其中段身体和尾部会摆动；化石未保存尾鳍。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 一种由较完整关联遗骸代表的大型原鲸科成员；此处未给出确切体长。
ecology.guildZh: 海洋捕食是根据解剖特征推断，并非观察到摄食行为。

traits: Unfused sacrals without a weight-bearing sacroiliac joint
Reduced limbs; a tail fluke is not securely preserved
evidenceSummary: CGM 60584 supplies locomotor anatomy, while 37.71 Ma falls amid competing stratigraphic interpretations; neither date nor performance is exact observation.

readerLimitations.en: The 37.71 Ma point is a display value amid competing stratigraphic interpretations, not an exact date for CGM 60584 or a genus endpoint. Predation and tail-driven swimming are anatomical hypotheses; prey, performance and a tail fluke are not directly documented.
readerLimitations.zh: 37.71 Ma 是在存在相互竞争的地层解释时采用的展示点，不是 CGM 60584 的精确年代，也不是该属的首末现时间。捕食与尾部推进游泳属于解剖学假说；猎物、游泳表现和尾鳍都未被直接记录。

evidenceSummaryZh: CGM 60584 记录了运动模型所用的解剖特征。图示的 37.71 Ma 位于竞争性的地层解释之间，并非标本精确年代或实际游泳记录。
traitsZh: 骶椎未融合，也没有承重的骶髂关节。
肢体退化；尾鳍是否存在尚无可靠保存证据。

commonNameZh: 地点组合的陆生早期鲸
geography: H-GSP Locality 62, Ganda Kas, Kala Chitta Hills, Punjab, Pakistan
overview: The cited account of *Pakicetus attocki* combines skull H-GSP 96231 with vertebrae and limb bones catalogued separately from H-GSP Locality 62 at Ganda Kas. These are unassociated specimens, not a single “wolf-sized” skeleton. Cetacean-like features in the skull’s ear region and weight-bearing, running-associated postcrania support a terrestrial early-whale interpretation.

ecology.diet: Diet is unresolved from the described skeleton and teeth; the study does not attribute prey remains to the sample
ecology.habitat: Terrestrial use is inferred from the locomotor skeleton; the locality and formation do not prove a shoreline microhabitat
ecology.locomotion: Running and terrestrial locomotion are inferred from limb proportions and osteology; performance was not observed
ecology.bodySize: Wolf-sized pakicetid in the authors' comparison
ecology.guild: Terrestrial early-cetacean interpretation with ecological guild bounded to the named sample

traits: Cetacean-like basicranial ear region in skull H-GSP 96231
Weight-bearing limbs and running adaptations in separately catalogued postcrania
evidenceSummary: The skull and postcranial bones from H-GSP Locality 62 are not one associated skeleton. Their anatomy supports a terrestrial body-plan interpretation, but does not establish a shoreline habitat or make *Pakicetus* a direct ancestor.

title.en: A locality composite of skull and postcrania
title.zh: H-GSP 62 号地点的组合复原

text.en: The cited account of *Pakicetus attocki* combines skull H-GSP 96231 with vertebrae and limb bones catalogued separately from H-GSP Locality 62 at Ganda Kas. These are unassociated specimens, not a single “wolf-sized” skeleton. Cetacean-like features in the skull’s ear region and weight-bearing, running-associated postcrania support a terrestrial early-whale interpretation.
text.zh: Pakicetus attocki 的复原把头骨 H-GSP 96231 与 H-GSP 62 号地点分别编目的椎骨和肢骨组合起来。它们来自同一地点，却不是同一具关联骨架。头骨耳区的鲸类样特征，以及颅后材料中的承重肢骨和奔跑相关特征，支持其具有显著陆地运动能力的早期鲸类解释。

title.en: The ear region and load-bearing postcrania
title.zh: 耳区头骨与分别编目的肢骨

text.en: Skull H-GSP 96231 has cetacean-like features in its basicranial ear region. Separately catalogued postcranial material from the locality preserves weight-bearing limb bones and features associated with running. The reconstruction combines these unassociated specimens rather than one skeleton.
text.zh: 头骨 H-GSP 96231 的基底颅区具有鲸类样耳部特征。分别编目的颅后材料保存了承重肢骨及与奔跑相关的特征。身体复原组合了同一地点的多件标本，而非一具彼此关联的骨架。

title.en: What the locality composite can support

text.en: Limb proportions and osteology support a terrestrial, running-adapted interpretation, but gait and performance were not observed. The locality and formation do not establish a shoreline microhabitat, and the cited study does not assign prey remains to the sample. “Wolf-sized” is an author comparison for this composite, not a mass measurement.
text.zh: 肢骨比例和骨骼结构支持陆地运动及奔跑适应的解释，却不是步态或运动表现的直接观察。地点和地层不能确定岸边微栖地，所引研究也没有把猎物遗骸归入这些材料。“狼大小”是作者对地点组合样本的比较描述，并非体重测量。

title.zh: 同一地点不等于同一具骨架

text.en: The skull and postcranial bones from H-GSP Locality 62 are not one associated skeleton. Their anatomy supports a terrestrial body-plan interpretation, but does not establish a shoreline habitat or make *Pakicetus* a direct ancestor.
text.zh: 头骨和颅后骨骼来自 H-GSP 62 号地点，却不是一具关联骨架。它们的解剖结构支持陆地型身体构型的解释，但不能确定具体岸边栖地；本页也不把 *Pakicetus* 写成直接祖先。

title.en: Skeletons of terrestrial cetaceans and the relationship of whales to artiodactyls
title.zh: Skeletons of terrestrial cetaceans and the relationship of whales to artiodactyls

scope.en: The Pakicetus reconstruction combines a skull and separately catalogued postcranial bones from one locality, not one associated skeleton.
scope.zh: Pakicetus 复原组合了同一地点的头骨与分别编目的颅后骨骼，并非一具关联骨架。

geography: Lowest Yumaque Member, Paracas Formation, Playa Media Luna, Pisco Basin, Peru
overview: MUSM 3580 preserves hind-limb anatomy consistent with weight bearing alongside aquatic adaptations; its ~42.6 Ma age is locality context, not a direct specimen date.

ecology.diet: Carnivory is inferred from cetacean dentition; prey and feeding behaviour are not preserved
ecology.habitat: Marine depositional context is documented, while amphibious habitat use is inferred from the skeleton
ecology.locomotion: Quadrupedal swimming and terrestrial weight bearing are functional reconstructions; no gait or swimming performance was observed
ecology.bodySize: Approximately 4 m long according to the reported skeletal dimensions
ecology.guild: Amphibious quadrupedal cetacean interpretation with route and behaviour unresolved

traits: Partial articulated holotype MUSM 3580 preserving mandibles and most major postcranial regions
Two fused sacrals, defined femoral head and hoof-like distal phalanges
Functional hind limbs alongside aquatic cetacean adaptations
evidenceSummary: MUSM 3580 anchors a Peruvian occurrence near 42.6 Ma; locomotion and westward dispersal are reconstructions, not observed activity.

title.en: MUSM 3580: hind limbs alongside aquatic adaptations
title.zh: 后足结构与水生适应并存

text.en: Holotype MUSM 3580 is a partial, articulated skeleton from Peru’s middle Eocene Yumaque Member, assigned in the dossier an age of about 42.6 million years. It preserves the jaws, much of the axial skeleton and portions of the limbs. Two fused sacrals, a defined femoral head and hoof-like toe bones make the hind-limb anatomy available for comparison alongside cetacean aquatic adaptations. The fossils support a mixed functional reconstruction, not a witnessed walk or swim; protocetid placement does not establish direct ancestry of later whales.
text.zh:
正模 MUSM 3580 是来自秘鲁中始新世 Yumaque 段的一具部分关节相连骨架，档案记录其年代约为 4,260 万年前。标本保存了下颌、相当部分的中轴骨骼及部分肢体。两块愈合的骶椎、明确的股骨头和蹄状趾骨，使后肢结构仍可供比较。

这些结构与鲸类的水生适应同时出现，因此 Peregocetus 记录了一种尚保留承重肢体解剖的身体构型。化石支持的是混合功能的复原，而非直接观察到行走或游泳；它在原鲸科中的位置也不能证明它是后期鲸类的直系祖先。

title.en: An amphibious whale from the middle Eocene of Peru reveals early South Pacific dispersal of quadrupedal cetaceans
title.zh: An amphibious whale from the middle Eocene of Peru reveals early South Pacific dispersal of quadrupedal cetaceans
